expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' tab has no icon while Home, Search and Profile all show an icon above their label. This leaves a blank space above 'Orders' and makes the tab look unfinished/broken and visually unbalanced.

The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the ramen card's heart sits directly on the image with no backdrop, while the pizza card's heart has a dark translucent circular scrim. On light imagery the un-scrimmed white heart would be hard to see.
The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving a contrast ratio likely below the 4.5:1 threshold for body text.
